items.title: Indigenous Culture and AI

children.content: What happens when the world's oldest continuous cultures come up against one of the newest technologies: artificial intelligence?
There are growing concerns about AI systems being trained on Indigenous artworks, language and cultural material.
There are also questions about who's generating this content, and who benefits from its proliferation.
For some it's innovation, for others it's cultural appropriation.
